summary: ProAssurance filed an 8-K updating the status of its pending merger with The Doctors Company. Under the Agreement and Plan of Merger dated March 19, 2025, a wholly owned subsidiary of The Doctors Company will merge into ProAssurance, which will survive as a wholly owned subsidiary. Stockholders approved the deal on June 24, 2025, and HSR clearance was obtained on July 2, 2025. Final insurance regulatory approvals have been received in seven states, Lloyd's, and the Cayman Islands, with only California pending. The transaction is expected to close by June 30, 2026. The key risk-arb watch is the timing of California's remaining approval.
